concept: DR strategies: multi-site active/active for minimal RPO/RTO
tests: Recognize the DR strategy with full capacity running in two Regions, traffic going to both.
expected: Multi-site active/active: full production capacity in several Regions serves live traffic, near-zero RPO/RTO. Triggers: "full production capacity in two Regions simultaneously", "traffic routed to both", "near-zero RPO and RTO".
why_not: Warm standby is a scaled-down copy that scales up on failover; pilot light and backup & restore recover even slower.
